description: Land Title Settlement Department - Waththalpola, Pomadura D/S Division, Kalutara District - Cad. Map No. 530024 (23/908)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains multiple declarations of determination by the Commissioner of Land Title Settlement regarding specific land parcels, including detailed property descriptions, ownership details, extent measurements, encumbrances, and servitude rights. The content focuses entirely on land registration and property ownership matters, falling squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
